summary: Small dirt pull-off in forest just off Mount Nebo Road, no homes near.
reasons: Bare dirt pad linked to the road
Only a hut about 48 m away

drivers.seclusion: Surrounded by dense forest. The only building is a non-dwelling about 48 m north-east, across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Bare dirt pad about 15 m long meets the road edge via a short track; a van should fit but it is tight.
drivers.traffic: Quiet mountain road; the pad is set off the lane.
drivers.convention: Mapped as parking at the lookout, so stopping here is expected.

flags: Steep: DEM about 11.6% mean, higher in places; the pad itself may be flatter
Tracks nearby are fire breaks, not for use
sun_shade: Tree canopy over most of it; partly open from the east and south over the pad.

best_section.where: Dirt pad at the ring, just south-west of the road bend
